rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making something better or for a situation that is getting better.

example.english: This new arrangement will improve the workflow.
example.traditional: 呢個新安排會改善工作流程。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 on1 paai4 wui5 goi2 sin6 gung1 zok3 lau4 cing4

rows.note: Use this when deliberately raising a level such as quality, value, efficiency, or productivity.

example.english: The company wants to improve its service quality.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 soeng2 tai4 sing1 fuk6 mou6 zat1 sou3

rows.note: Use this when a person’s health or physical condition improves or returns to normal.

example.english: After taking the medicine, my health will improve a lot.
example.traditional: 食咗藥之後，我會好返好多。
example.jyutping: sik6 zo2 joek6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 wui5 hou2 faan1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when someone improves in ability, performance, studies, or skill.

example.english: If you keep practising, your English will improve quickly.
example.traditional: 你繼續練習，英文就會進步得好快。
example.jyutping: nei5 gai3 zuk6 lin6 zaap6 jing1 man4 zau6 wui5 zeon3 bou6 dak1 hou2 faai3
